name: @oa-sdk/orchestrator-gitlab
description: GitLab-native coding-agent orchestrator. Phase A MVP — polls labelled issues, spawns isolated workspaces, runs a pluggable agent (Codex / Claude / custom), and reports back via GitLab notes.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/cli.ts src/agents/echo.ts src/agents/codex.ts --format esm --dts --clean
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts src/cli.ts src/agents/echo.ts src/agents/codex.ts --format esm --dts --watch
